nginx.addSiteSubtitle: A config file will be generated at {dir}/{name}.conf
nginx.staticHint: Serve static files only, no PHP parsing

nginx.siteCreateHint: Fill in at least one of Web Root or Reverse Proxy Address. If a proxy address is provided, config will be generated as reverse proxy; otherwise it follows the site type with auto-created root dir and default index page (index.html for static HTML, index.php for PHP; existing files with the same name will not be overwritten). When PHP is selected, installed php-fpm will be auto-detected and fastcgi_pass written into the config; creation will be refused if no PHP-FPM is detected. nginx -t validation runs on creation and rolls back on failure. SSL and database creation failures will not affect the site itself.

nginx.noRootForFiles: This site has no document root configured, file management is unavailable
nginx.stopSiteHint: Take the site offline: its config is moved out of the Nginx include path and reloaded, and the domain shows a stopped page

nginx.restartSiteHint: Restart the site: a stopped site is brought back online; an online site just reloads its config
nginx.isolationOnHint: Directory isolation is on: PHP can only read and write this site's directory and /tmp, and cannot reach other sites' files
nginx.isolationOffHint: This site is not isolated, so PHP can read other sites' files on this server. Click to inject open_basedir for this site (writes the config and reloads Nginx)
